_about: Icon refresh map read by Tools/EBMC/build_icons.py. Keys are paths under StaticData/Icons and must name existing .png files there, except directly inside Shapes/ (the shapes palette's own glyphs), where build_icons.py creates them. source is lucide:<name> (Tools/EBMC/icons/lucide/<name>.svg, 79 vendored files) or custom:<name> (Tools/EBMC/icons/custom/<name>.svg, 48 EBMC drawings). size is the output PNG edge in pixels: 4x the logical size the code loads (64 for 16x16, 56 for 14x14, 48 for 12x12, 96 for 24x24, 128 for 32x32; Library/folder.png is loaded at its own size and stays 256). color (optional, #RRGGBB, saturated) bakes that colour into the pixels instead of black, for status icons whose colour carries meaning; GrayToColor tinting leaves saturated pixels alone. glyph (optional, px) renders the drawing at that size centred on the size x size canvas, for callers that load the icon into a larger box than the glyph should fill. At device scale 1 the app's loader halves these exactly (64->32->16). At device scale 2 it first resamples the source up by 2 (64->128, bilinear) and then halves it twice to 32 px, so the result is close to, but slightly softer than, an exact 2x box reduction. previously_untinted marks icons whose code did not tint them before the refresh (used only by the preview sheet). Shapes/ glyphs are 80 px masters for 20 px palette buttons; the palette loads them with its own loader, which box-halves straight to the device size, so 1x and 2x are both exact.
